fusions.name: Scent Bead
fusions.desc: Flicks a bead of water that deals 7 damage and leaves the target [Marked] for 8 seconds. It holds 3 charges and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Final Approach
fusions.desc: Closes on a target and deals 28 damage, leaving it 12% easier to wound for 6 seconds. Against a boss or an elite it also deals 5% of their maximum health. You move 20% faster for 4 seconds after it.

fusions.name: Fresh Scent
fusions.desc: Clears the cooldown on one of your other abilities, chosen at random from those still waiting. You move 20% faster for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Closing Circle
fusions.desc: Against enemies below half health, you deal 15% more damage.
